description: A 16-panel composite of secondary-electron (SE) SEM micrographs of the Fe-Mn-Al-Cu 17Al low-density steel after aging, arranged in four rows (temperature) and four columns (aging time). Row 1: 525 ℃ at 1, 3, 6 and 10 h; row 2: 550 ℃ at 1, 3, 6 and 10 h; row 3: 575 ℃ at 1, 3, 6 and 10 h; row 4: 600 ℃ - 1 h, 600 ℃ - 3 h, 625 ℃ - 1 h, 650 ℃ - 1 h. Every main panel carries a 50 µm scale bar; smaller insets (scale bars marked 2 µm or 10 µm, partially readable) show fine-scale detail. Green arrows/labels mark β-Mn, red labels mark the α matrix, blue labels in insets mark α-Mn, and magenta labels mark "New precipitates". At 525 ℃ precipitation is sparse — rare β-Mn along α grain boundaries up to 6 h — whereas at 550 ℃ the matrix is essentially transformed by 6-10 h, matching the caption/citing text that α→β-Mn in 17Al is complete after 6 h at 550 ℃ but after only 1 h at 600 ℃ and above. The later panels show dense fine dot-like precipitates inside the transformed β-Mn matrix.

subfigures.description: 525 ℃ - 1 h: low-magnification SE image with green β-Mn arrows pointing to sparse precipitate at an α grain boundary; 50 µm scale bar.
525 ℃ - 3 h: similar grain-boundary structure, green β-Mn arrow to a slightly larger grain-boundary precipitate; 50 µm scale bar.
525 ℃ - 6 h: β-Mn label on a grain-boundary feature plus an inset (scale bar marked 2 µm) labelled α-Mn in blue; 50 µm scale bar on the main panel.
525 ℃ - 10 h: unlabelled SE image showing only faint contrast variations of the α matrix; 50 µm scale bar.
550 ℃ - 1 h: SE image with red α labels on both sides and a green β-Mn arrow to a grain-boundary phase; inset labelled α-Mn (blue); 50 µm scale bar.
550 ℃ - 3 h: unlabelled matrix with faint grain-boundary contrast, partial transformation; 50 µm scale bar.
550 ℃ - 6 h: essentially featureless matrix labelled β-Mn (green); 50 µm scale bar.
550 ℃ - 10 h: uniform matrix labelled β-Mn (green); 50 µm scale bar.
575 ℃ - 1 h: elongated/needle-like contrast within the α matrix (untransformed structure), no labels; 50 µm scale bar.
575 ℃ - 3 h: uniform grey matrix, earlier needle-like contrast no longer resolved; 50 µm scale bar.
575 ℃ - 6 h: uniform matrix with an inset (magenta arrow, "New precipitates") showing dense fine dot-like particles; 50 µm scale bar.
575 ℃ - 10 h: uniform β-Mn matrix, no inset; 50 µm scale bar.
600 ℃ - 1 h: green β-Mn label with an inset (magenta "New precipitates") showing numerous fine precipitates; 50 µm scale bar.
600 ℃ - 3 h: uniform grey β-Mn matrix, no labels or inset; 50 µm scale bar.
625 ℃ - 1 h: uniform matrix with inset (magenta "New precipitates") of fine particles; 50 µm scale bar.
650 ℃ - 1 h: matrix with inset (magenta "New precipitates", arrow) showing fine precipitates; the inset is the least sharp of the group; 50 µm scale bar.

observations.observation: The figure is a 16-panel montage of secondary-electron SEM images of the 17Al alloy; rows correspond to aging temperatures 525, 550 and 575 ℃ (plus 600 ℃ - 1 h, 600 ℃ - 3 h, 625 ℃ - 1 h, 650 ℃ - 1 h in the bottom row) and columns to aging times 1, 3, 6 and 10 h.
Every main panel carries a 50 µm scale bar.
Green arrows labelled β-Mn point to grain-boundary precipitates in the 525 ℃ - 1 h, 525 ℃ - 3 h and 525 ℃ - 6 h panels, i.e. precipitation at 525 ℃ remains sparse.
Insets labelled α-Mn (blue text) are present in the 525 ℃ - 6 h panel (inset scale bar marked 2 µm) and in the 550 ℃ - 1 h panel.
In the 550 ℃ - 1 h panel, the α matrix is labelled in red at the left and right edges while a green β-Mn arrow points to a grain-boundary phase, so both α and β-Mn coexist at that condition.
The 575 ℃ - 1 h panel shows elongated needle-like contrast inside the α matrix, whereas the 575 ℃ - 6 h, 575 ℃ - 10 h and 600 ℃ - 1 h panels are uniform and in the 600 ℃ - 1 h case labelled β-Mn.

Magenta labels reading "New precipitates" with inset arrows appear in the 575 ℃ - 6 h, 600 ℃ - 1 h, 625 ℃ - 1 h and 650 ℃ - 1 h panels; the insets show dense fine dot-like particles within the transformed matrix.
No numerical hardness, phase-fraction or composition values are printed on any panel of this figure.
The caption states the figure shows secondary electronic (SE) images of the 17Al alloy after different aging treatments.
The citing text states that the α matrix had nearly fully transformed into β-Mn in the 17Al alloy after 6 h of aging at 550 ℃.
The citing text states that increasing Al content slowed the precipitation kinetics of β-Mn during low-temperature aging.
The citing text states that β-Mn primarily precipitated along α grain boundaries, while a small amount of short rod-shaped β-Mn was also observed within the α grains.
The citing text states that at 600 ℃ and above the α phase had almost completely transformed into β-Mn in both alloys after just 1 h of aging.
The citing text states that the 17Al alloy aged at 575 ℃ for 1 h was selected for XRD testing (Fig. 10), where both α-Mn and β-Mn diffraction peaks were found.

unreadable_items: Inset scale bars: the 525 ℃ - 6 h inset bar (appears to read 2 µm) and the row-3/row-4 inset bars (appear to read 10 µm) are only partially readable at the supplied resolution
Fine-particle morphology inside the 650 ℃ - 1 h inset is blurred; individual precipitate shapes cannot be resolved
The 575 ℃ - 10 h panel (l) carries no text label, so the phase present there is inferred from the citing text rather than read from the image
